Questions? Will callers be able to tell they're talking to AI? Rachel answers in a warm, natural, conversational voice and handles the back-and-forth of a real call in real time. Most callers simply feel like they reached a friendly, professional receptionist who actually picked up — which beats sending them to voicemail every time. What happens if Rachel can't handle a call? She hands it off. Rachel can transfer a live call straight to you or a team member — your cell or your office line — so anything that needs a human reaches one without the caller getting stuck. Can Rachel book appointments into my calendar? Yes. Rachel syncs with your Google or Outlook calendar to schedule appointments, send invites, and even handle reschedules — without double-booking or the usual back-and-forth. Do I get a phone number, or does Rachel use my existing one? When you sign up, Rachel is assigned her own phone number that she answers around the clock. She can also transfer calls to your existing cell or office line whenever a call needs you directly. Which countries does Rachel support? Rachel can get a local phone number in the US, Canada, the UK, Mexico, and Australia, and answers calls around the clock in any of them. Can Rachel handle callers who don't speak English? Yes. Rachel understands and responds in multiple languages, including Spanish and French. She detects the caller's language and switches automatically, so everyone feels heard. Does Rachel work after hours, weekends, and on my day off? Always. Rachel answers every call 24/7, so you stop losing business to missed calls when you're with a customer, off the clock, or simply trying to take a break. Can Rachel replace my answering service? Yes. Rachel works as a 24/7 AI answering service: she picks up every call on her own number, takes messages, books appointments and transfers urgent calls straight to you. You get the coverage of a traditional answering service at a fraction of the cost. How does Rachel get set up, and what does she cost? Setup is quick — once you sign up she gets her number and starts answering, with guided onboarding to get her sounding right for your business. Rachel is included in every Marblism plan from $24/month on the yearly option, alongside the rest of your AI team, and you can cancel anytime.
